model:
Reads the coupled cases of tcpmt_z3land_variants (research/final_closure/sensitivity/
etm_Z3_HV_S0__z3_land_*.json) and the three-tier reference cases, and writes
research/tcpmt_revision/z3_land_coupled.json:

board_allocation.status: DECLARED (not in the Z3 design record)
board_allocation.basis: four of the fourteen 1-oz layers of the 18-layer schedule (pcb_h1: 14 x 1 oz + 4 x 2 oz) carry the two 1 V rails; the four 2-oz central planes instead would halve the loss

R_star.meaning: 0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed
0 = Z3 behind Z1 even with a lossless 48 V feed

tie_with_board_planes.method: quadratic in 1/t through the three nearest runs

tie_land_only.method: quadratic in 1/t through the three nearest runs
tie_land_only.basis: coupled runs minus the board planes' coupled increment (measured at t = 40 um by the no-plane control, scaled by each run's plane row)

tie_with_2oz_central_planes.method: quadratic in 1/t through the three nearest runs
tie_with_2oz_central_planes.basis: board planes on the four 2-oz central layers (2 x 69.6 um per rail): half the 2 x 35 um plane term, same scaling

derived.drop_rule: land-side static spread (max - min of the rail plane potential, FV) at the DC rail current 1000 A, rho_Cu at the coupled land-side temperature of the cooling-B runs (interpolated in 1/t)

equal_sharing_context.note: free sharing puts ~365 of ~685 balls per rail above the 1.5 A criterion that set the 667-ball count (max ~3.3-3.4 A); equal sharing is what that criterion presumes
